description.content: Side-loads the node's own latest confirmed snapshot, Hydra's documented recovery for a stuck head. That snapshot is already signed by every party, so nothing new enters the head: the stuck round and its unconfirmed transactions (`droppedTxIds`) are discarded. Refused unless the round in flight still matches `expectedSignature`, has been stuck for ten minutes, and the counterparty has not confirmed a later snapshot than this node nor is more than one behind it (`peerConfirmedSnapshotNumber`, which the counterparty's operator reads off their node: its API is not reachable from here, so this service cannot check it itself).
